SELECT item_name AS name, CASE
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%음식물%' THEN 'food'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%소형전기전자제품%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%소형전기전제품%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%전기전자제품%' THEN 'electronics'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%폐의약품%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%유해폐기물%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%농약%' THEN 'medicine'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%전지%' THEN 'battery'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%의류 수거함%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%의류수거함%' THEN 'clothes'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%비닐%' THEN 'vinyl'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%유리병%' THEN 'glass'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%금속캔%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%고철%' THEN 'can'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%종이%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%종이팩%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%골판지%' THEN 'paper'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%플라스틱%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%무색페트병%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%스티로폼%' THEN 'plastic'
WHEN disposal_method LIKE '%대형폐기물%' OR disposal_method LIKE '%무상방문수거%' THEN 'large'
ELSE 'general'
END AS category
FROM recycle_item
ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{count}
